title: Effective profile rule (admin and resolver vectors)
description: Effective value of one profile rule with its source, as computed by the resolver (tools/profiles_ref.py). Admin view: GET /api/pairing/clients/{client_id}/effective; resolver vectors: fixtures/profiles/resolve. Unlike client_config.rules (resolved-rules.json) the value is untyped here and null for not applicable rules.

value.description: Effective value (schema: profile-rule-values.json#/properties/<key>); null when not applicable.

locked.description: The person at the device must not change it (not user_choice).

fixed.description: The admin cannot adjust the rule on this device (checkbox “Fixed”, rule without checkbox, boundary that decides the rule, not applicable).

user_choice.description: The person at the device decides; value is the starting value. Missing = false.

expires_at.description: End of a temporary device adjustment; also on a rule whose boundary only that adjustment lifts (watch while a temporary kids_watch runs, catalog 9); missing = null.

profile_value.description: Admin view only: value of the profile (or catalog default) before device adjustment and boundaries, for “Adjusted · profile: …”.

enforcement.description: Who enforces the rule on this device: ha/hub = shown “Enforced”, app = “Applies in <brand>” (someone with their own Home Assistant access is not bound by it). Missing = see the catalog.
